description:
Generate a multi-Reynolds number aerodynamic dataset for a NACA 4415 airfoil. 

1. Open QBlade and generate a NACA 4415 airfoil.
2. Run three separate XFoil analyses at Reynolds numbers: 1,000,000 (1M), 3,000,000 (3M), and 5,000,000 (5M). Use Ncrit=9 and an alpha range of -5 to 20 degrees.
3. Extrapolate all three polars to 360 degrees using the Viterna method.
4. Export the three extrapolated polars to: 
   - ~/Documents/polars/NACA4415_1M_360.dat
   - ~/Documents/polars/NACA4415_3M_360.dat
   - ~/Documents/polars/NACA4415_5M_360.dat
5. Save the project to ~/Documents/projects/re_dataset_study.wpa.
